decisions.decision: Overlay writes the img src directly in the rVFC callback and keeps the state update as a no-op commit
decisions.rationale: React commit latency cost one whole video frame; excess lag went from p50 0.030/p99 0.312 to 0 across the board

decisions.decision: engine.swap and cv2.imencode run under asyncio.to_thread
decisions.rationale: they starved the event loop; a status read measured 4.3s during a run against 6ms idle, which is what a client timeout turns into a 500

decisions.decision: Forced stop cancels and returns without awaiting, reaping in the background, and settles abandoned processing rows as cancelled
decisions.rationale: an unsettled row pins the recording watermark under it forever

decisions.decision: drain_to waits for, rather than bounds, a pump already released by finish()
decisions.rationale: the stop's bound is the last generated timestamp, which on a range run is behind where the full drain has reached, so it truncated the tail

decisions.decision: The pump finalizes itself on end-of-source, with aclose lock-guarded
decisions.rationale: a run nobody stopped parked on a .part forever; the lock stops the later stop racing the promote/export

decisions.decision: Start_Studio.bat serves everything from uvicorn on one port instead of running vite
